Level1.Name: blockmacros
Level1.Description: Block macros from running in Word files originating from the Internet (Mark of the Web).

Level1.Name: blockmacros
Level1.Description: Block macros from running in Excel files originating from the Internet (Mark of the Web).

Level1.Name: blockmacros
Level1.Description: Block macros from running in PowerPoint files originating from the Internet (Mark of the Web).

Level1.Name: AllowDDE
Level1.Description: Disable Dynamic Data Exchange (DDE) in Word to prevent DDE auto-execution exploits.

Level1.Name: DisableDDEServerLookup
Level1.Description: Disable Dynamic Data Exchange (DDE) server lookup in Excel to prevent DDE auto-execution exploits.

Level1.Name: DisableFlash
Level1.Description: Block Shockwave Flash objects from activating in all Office applications (Flash is EOL).

Level2.Name: VBAWarnings
Level2.Description: Disable all macros in Word except those digitally signed by a trusted publisher.

Level2.Name: VBAWarnings
Level2.Description: Disable all macros in Excel except those digitally signed by a trusted publisher.

Level2.Name: VBAWarnings
Level2.Description: Disable all macros in PowerPoint except those digitally signed by a trusted publisher.

Level2.Name: PackagerPrompt
Level2.Description: Block Object Packager from running any embedded executable files within Office documents.

Level2.Name: DisableAllActiveX
Level2.Description: Disable all ActiveX controls in Office applications without notification.

Level3.Name: VBAWarnings
Level3.Description: Disable all macros in Word entirely without notification (High Security/Non-Dev users).

Level3.Name: VBAWarnings
Level3.Description: Disable all macros in Excel entirely without notification (High Security/Non-Dev users).

Level3.Name: VBAWarnings
Level3.Description: Disable all macros in PowerPoint entirely without notification (High Security/Non-Dev users).

Level3.Name: Excel2003andEarlier
Level3.Description: Force Excel to block the opening of legacy Excel 2003 (and earlier) files and prevents bypassing Protected View.

Level3.Name: Word2003andEarlier
Level3.Description: Force Word to block the opening of legacy Word 2003 (and earlier) files and prevents bypassing Protected View.

Level3.Name: BlockInsecureProtocols
Level3.Description: Block all non-HTTPS protocols when opening documents, eliminating downgrade paths and unsafe connections.

Level3.Name: BlockOLEGraph
Level3.Description: Prevent legacy MSGraph (OLE Graph components) from executing; forces Office to render static images instead.

Level3.Name: BlockExtensibility
Level3.Description: Prevent Office applications from loading unapproved add-ins.
